AccessLogPolicy.description: AccessLogPolicy is nginx access_log with log_format. One applies: the closest to the route.

enabled.description: False turns logging off for the routes it applies to.

escapeJson.description: Escape values for JSON; implied by format "json".

format.description: "combined" (default), "main", "json", or a template with nginx variables.

Action.description: Action carries the settings for Type and nothing else.

AdditionFilter.description: AdditionFilter is nginx add_before_body, add_after_body and addition_types: the answers of subrequests to these paths around 200 responses. Both paths empty turns off an addition filter inherited from further out.

types.description: Media types besides text/html, or "*" for any.

Autoindex.description: Autoindex is nginx autoindex and its settings.

approximateSize.description: HTML sizes rounded to K, M and G (autoindex_exact_size off).

localTime.description: HTML times in the proxy's local time zone instead of UTC.

key.description: hash and hash_consistent: the key, with variables, such as "$request_uri".

BandwidthPolicy.description: BandwidthPolicy is nginx limit_rate and limit_rate_after: the response body rate of each request. The closest policy applies.

after.description: Sent at full speed first, such as "500k".

rate.description: Such as "100k" or "1m" bytes per second.

BasicAuthPolicy.description: BasicAuthPolicy is nginx auth_basic with the users inline. The closest policy applies.

hash.description: A hash as htpasswd or openssl passwd makes: bcrypt, $apr1$, $1$, $5$, $6$, {SHA} or {SSHA}.

CachePolicy.description: CachePolicy is nginx proxy_cache_path with proxy_cache and the proxy_cache_* directives. Each policy is one cache zone shared by every proxy route it applies to; the closest policy applies. Other routes ignore it.

backgroundUpdate.description: Answer expired entries at once and refresh after; needs useStale "updating".

bypass.description: CEL expressions over request, as route matches. Bypass answers from the upstream and still stores (proxy_cache_bypass); noStore does not store (proxy_no_cache).

enabled.description: False turns caching off for the routes it applies to (proxy_cache off); the other settings are then unused.

ignore.description: Upstream headers whose caching instructions are ignored: "X-Accel-Expires", "Expires", "Cache-Control", "Set-Cookie", "Vary".

inactive.description: Entries not used for this long are removed. Default "10m".

keepHead.description: HEAD goes upstream as HEAD, not GET (proxy_cache_convert_head off).

levels.description: Subdirectory name lengths, each 1 or 2, at most three (nginx levels=1:2). Default [1, 2].

lock.description: One request per key goes upstream; the others wait up to lockTimeout (default "5s") for its response.

maxSize.description: Disk size at most, such as "1g"; least recently used entries go first. Empty: unlimited.

methods.description: Methods cached. Default GET and HEAD.

minUses.description: Requests for a key before its response is stored. Default 1.

path.description: Directory of the entries. Relative or empty: under the proxy data directory in proxy/cache, named after the policy ID by default.

revalidate.description: Refresh expired entries with conditional requests.

slice.description: Fetch and store ranges of this size apart, such as "1m" (nginx slice); the key gets $slice_range when it is the default. Valid times should include 206.

useStale.description: When an expired entry answers instead (proxy_cache_use_stale): "error", "timeout", "updating", "http_500", "http_502", "http_503", "http_504", "http_403", "http_404", "http_429".

valid.description: Freshness by status when the upstream does not say (proxy_cache_valid). Responses without either are not stored.

CertStatus.description: CertStatus is what the control plane read from the chain, or the last issuance error.

chainPem.description: PEM, leaf first. For acme, filled in when issued.

domains.description: For acme: the names to issue for.

keyPem.description: PEM private key. Never returned by the API.

CharsetFilter.description: CharsetFilter is nginx charset, source_charset, override_charset, charset_types and charset_map: the charset added to Content-Type, and responses recoded to it from Source.

charset.description: Added to Content-Type as "; charset=". "off" turns off a charset filter inherited from further out.

override.description: Also recode responses that state a charset (override_charset).

source.description: The charset of responses that state none. Recoding to Charset needs a Map between the two.

types.description: Media types besides text/html, or "*" for any. Empty: nginx's charset_types default (text/html, text/xml, text/plain, text/vnd.wap.wml, application/javascript, application/rss+xml).

CharsetMap.description: CharsetMap is one nginx charset_map: how the bytes of From stand for characters of To, used for recoding either way.

bytes.description: A byte of From as two hex digits to the To byte as two hex digits, or to the UTF-8 bytes in hex when To is "utf-8" ("C0": "D18E"). Unlisted bytes below 80 are themselves; the others become "?".

ClientAuth.description: ClientAuth asks for a client certificate. A missing (require) or invalid one answers 400; the result is in $ssl_client_verify.

ca.description: PEM CA certificates that sign client certificates (nginx ssl_client_certificate). Required unless mode is optional_no_ca.

depth.description: Chain length at most (nginx ssl_verify_depth). Zero: 1.

CompressionPolicy.description: CompressionPolicy is nginx gzip, gzip_static and gunzip, plus brotli and zstd. The closest policy applies.

disable.description: PCRE2 pattern; clients whose User-Agent matches get plain responses (nginx gzip_disable).

encodings.description: Dynamic encodings in order of preference: "gzip", "br", "zstd". The first one the client accepts is used. Empty: none, only static and gunzip apply.

gunzip.description: Decode gzip responses for clients that do not accept gzip (nginx gunzip).

http10.description: Also encode for HTTP/1.0 clients (nginx gzip_http_version 1.0).

minLength.description: Responses shorter than this are sent as is, such as "1k" (nginx gzip_min_length). Empty: 20 bytes.

proxied.description: Encode responses to requests with Via when one of these holds (nginx gzip_proxied): "expired", "no-cache", "no-store", "private", "no_last_modified", "no_etag", "auth", "any". Empty: never.

static.description: Serve file.gz next to a static file: "on" to clients that accept gzip, "always" to all (nginx gzip_static).

types.description: Media types encoded besides text/html, or "*" for any (nginx gzip_types).

ConnLimitPolicy.description: ConnLimitPolicy is nginx limit_conn_zone with limit_conn: requests in progress per key.

key.description: Template for the key, "$binary_remote_addr" by default.

status.description: Status for rejected requests, 503 by default.

CookieEdits.description: CookieEdits rewrites Set-Cookie of upstream responses (nginx proxy_cookie_domain, proxy_cookie_path and proxy_cookie_flags).

domains.description: Domain attributes equal to a pattern, ignoring case and a leading dot; with regex, as a PCRE2 ignoring case.

flags.description: The first entry naming a cookie sets its flags.

cookie.description: Cookie name ignoring case, or a caseless PCRE2 with Regex; an empty regex matches every cookie.

DAV.description: DAV is nginx dav_methods with create_full_put_path, min_delete_depth and dav_access.

access.description: Permission bits of created files as octal, "0644". Directories also get x where r is set. Default "0600".

minDeleteDepth.description: DELETE needs at least this many path segments.

Discovery.description: Discovery finds an upstream's targets with a service registry. The control plane polls it and sends what it finds to every proxy; the rest of the upstream (balancing, health checks, keepalive) applies to them as to configured targets. When the registry cannot be read the last targets found stay.

endpoint.description: docker: the Engine API, "unix:///var/run/docker.sock" by default or "http://host:port". kubernetes: the API server, by default the in-cluster one (KUBERNETES_SERVICE_HOST, service account token and CA). consul: the agent, "http://127.0.0.1:8500" by default.

interval.description: How often the registry is read. Default "10s".

network.description: docker: the network whose container address is used. Empty: the first one.

port.description: Port on the targets. docker: the container port, used with the container's address on network; kubernetes: the port name or number of the EndpointSlice; consul: overrides the service port.

selector.description: docker: running containers with every one of these labels ("key=value" or "key"). kubernetes: the Service whose EndpointSlices give the targets, as "namespace/name". consul: the service name.

tag.description: consul: only services with this tag; kubernetes and consul: a token for the API (kubernetes default: the service account's).

ErrorPage.description: ErrorPage is nginx error_page. Exactly one of URI and Route is set.

route.description: Route ID handling the error like an nginx named location (@name); its path match is not used.

status.description: Nil keeps the original code, 0 takes the redirected request's status (nginx "error_page 404 = /x"), anything else replaces the code.

uri.description: Path for an internal redirect, or an absolute http(s) URL for a redirect.

FiltersPolicy.description: FiltersPolicy holds response body filters. Each filter is taken from the closest policy that sets it, as nginx merges each module on its own.

ForwardAuthPolicy.description: ForwardAuthPolicy is nginx auth_request: an upstream decides whether to serve each request. It gets a GET with the request headers and X-Forwarded-Method, -Proto, -Host and -Uri; 2xx allows, 401 and 403 are sent to the client, anything else is a 500. The closest policy applies.

copyHeaders.description: Response headers of a successful check added to the request sent upstream; also variables $auth_resp_<name>.

uri.description: Path and query of the check, a template. Default "/".

GatewayAction.description: GatewayAction passes requests to an application server (nginx fastcgi_pass, uwsgi_pass, scgi_pass). The request body is read in full first.

documentRoot.description: $document_root, an absolute path; SCRIPT_FILENAME of FastCGI is $document_root$fastcgi_script_name.

index.description: Appended to $fastcgi_script_name for a URI ending in "/", for example "index.php" (fastcgi_index).

interceptErrors.description: Upstream responses of 300 or more that the route has an error page for get the page (nginx proxy_intercept_errors and the like). Not for memcached.

noRequestHeaders.description: Do not send request headers as HTTP_* params.

params.description: Added after the standard set of the protocol (nginx fastcgi_params, uwsgi_params, scgi_params); a param of the same name replaces the standard one. Values are templates.

redirects.description: Rewrites of Location and the URL of Refresh in upstream responses, the first match wins (nginx proxy_redirect). Only for proxy actions.

splitPathInfo.description: PCRE2 with two groups over $uri, the script name and the path info, for example "^(.+\.php)(/.+)$" (fastcgi_split_path_info).

ifNotEmpty.description: Skip the param when the value expands to nothing.

GeoTable.description: GeoTable is nginx geo: the longest network that contains the address wins.

add.description: Added alongside existing headers of the same name.

always.description: Response headers only: send with every status (nginx always).

set.description: Header name to value template; replaces headers with that name. On responses, sent only with success and redirect statuses unless Always.

HeaderRewrite.description: HeaderRewrite replaces the start of a header value, or with regex the whole value; Replacement is a template that may use $1..$9 of a regex.

HeadersPolicy.description: HeadersPolicy replaces nginx add_header, proxy_set_header and proxy_hide_header. Several headers policies merge by header name, the closer one winning.

request.description: Headers of the request sent upstream.

HealthCheck.description: HealthCheck probes every target; a target failing `fails` probes in a row takes no requests until it passes `passes` in a row.

body.description: PCRE2 pattern the response body must match.

host.description: HTTP Host header. Empty: the upstream's name.

port.description: Probe this port instead of the target's.

statuses.description: Passing statuses such as "200-399" or "204". Empty: 200-399.

IPAccessPolicy.description: IPAccessPolicy is nginx allow and deny. Rules of all policies that apply are checked in order, outermost first; the first match decides and no match allows. A denied request gets 403.

JWTPolicy.description: JWTPolicy is nginx auth_jwt: requests need a JSON Web Token signed by one of the keys, unexpired and, when set, from the issuer for one of the audiences. Others get 401 with WWW-Authenticate: Bearer. The claims are variables $jwt_claim_<name> and the token header $jwt_header_<name>. The closest policy applies.

audiences.description: The aud claim must hold one of these.

jwks.description: A JSON Web Key Set (RFC 7517) with the signing keys.

jwksUrl.description: Or where to fetch it; both may be set.

keyCache.description: How long fetched keys are kept. Default 1h.

leeway.description: Clock skew allowed for exp and nbf.

token.description: A template giving the token, for example "$cookie_token". Default: the Bearer credentials of the Authorization header.

idle.description: Idle connections kept per worker (nginx keepalive).

maxAge.description: A connection closes after being open this long (nginx keepalive_time). Empty: "1h".

defaultSite.description: Site ID served when no hostname matches (nginx default_server).

http2.description: Offer HTTP/2 through ALPN; requires TLS.

http3.description: HTTP3 also serves HTTP/3 over QUIC on the same UDP address (TLS 1.3, the same certificates) and advertises it with Alt-Svc.

ciphers.description: OpenSSL cipher list for TLS 1.2 and below (nginx ssl_ciphers). Empty: "HIGH:!aNULL:!MD5".

ciphersuites.description: TLS 1.3 suites, e.g. "TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256" (nginx ssl_conf_command Ciphersuites). Empty: OpenSSL's.

clientAuth.description: Client certificate check (nginx ssl_verify_client). Nil: none.

defaultCertificate.description: Certificate ID for handshakes without SNI or whose name selects a site without certificates. Empty: those handshakes fail.

dhParams.description: PEM DH parameters for DHE suites (nginx ssl_dhparam). Empty: none.

groups.description: Key exchange groups, e.g. "X25519:prime256v1" (nginx ssl_ecdh_curve). Empty: OpenSSL's.

preferServerCiphers.description: Server cipher order over the client's (nginx ssl_prefer_server_ciphers).

sessionCacheSize.description: Sessions kept for resumption by ID, per worker (nginx ssl_session_cache builtin:N). Zero: no cache.

LookupSpec.description: LookupSpec carries the table for Type and nothing else.

source.description: Template looked up, such as "$http_user_agent". geo: an address, $remote_addr when empty.

variable.description: Variable name without '$': lowercase letters, digits and '_'. Empty: the resource name with '-' as '_'.

value.description: A template; a regex's groups are $1..$9.

MapTable.description: MapTable is nginx map. Exact keys compare case-insensitively and win; regexes are then tried in order.

default.description: Value when nothing matches, a template. Empty: an empty value.

hostnames.description: Keys may be "*.example.com", ".example.com" or "www.example.*" (nginx map hostnames).

Match.description: Match selects requests by path (nginx location) and, optionally, by conditions checked after the path. Routes with the same path in one block are tried in order with their conditions, then the one without.

expr.description: CEL expression over `request` (see proxelo.expr.v1.Request) that must be a bool, with the standard library and the network extension.

query.description: Query argument conditions; names are case-sensitive.

MemcachedAction.description: MemcachedAction answers GET and HEAD with the value stored under the key (nginx memcached_pass); a missing key is 404.

interceptErrors.description: Upstream responses of 300 or more that the route has an error page for get the page (nginx proxy_intercept_errors and the like). Not for memcached.

redirects.description: Rewrites of Location and the URL of Refresh in upstream responses, the first match wins (nginx proxy_redirect). Only for proxy actions.

Mirror.description: Mirror is nginx mirror and mirror_request_body. Each copy runs through the site's routes as a subrequest with the method, query and body of the original; internal routes are reachable.

noRequestBody.description: Send copies without the request body (mirror_request_body off).

OIDCPolicy.description: OIDCPolicy signs users in with an OpenID Connect provider before their requests are served: the authorization code flow with PKCE, then a signed session cookie. The user's sub and email are variables $oidc_sub and $oidc_email. The closest policy applies.

clientSecret.description: Never returned by the API; empty on update keeps the stored one.

logoutUri.description: A path that signs the user out, then goes to the provider's logout or to PostLogoutURI.

redirectUri.description: Where the provider sends users back, a path on the site or a URL whose path reaches a route with this policy. Default "/oidc_callback".

PassiveHealth.description: PassiveHealth is nginx max_fails and fail_timeout.

PolicySpec.description: PolicySpec carries the settings for Type and nothing else.

interceptErrors.description: Upstream responses of 300 or more that the route has an error page for get the page (nginx proxy_intercept_errors and the like). Not for memcached.

redirects.description: Rewrites of Location and the URL of Refresh in upstream responses, the first match wins (nginx proxy_redirect). Only for proxy actions.

ProxyTimeouts.description: ProxyTimeouts are Go durations such as "5s". Empty: 60s, the nginx defaults.

size.description: Zero: no queue; a request finding every target full fails with 502.

RateLimitPolicy.description: RateLimitPolicy is nginx limit_req_zone with limit_req: a leaky bucket per key. Each policy is one zone; every route it applies to shares the zone's counters. All rate limits that apply are checked.

burst.description: Requests over the rate that wait (or pass, up to Delay) instead of being rejected.

delay.description: Excess requests passed without waiting (nginx delay). NoDelay passes the whole burst.

dryRun.description: Count and log, but never delay or reject.

key.description: Template for the key, "$binary_remote_addr" by default. Requests whose key is empty are not limited.

maxKeys.description: Keys kept per proxy; when full, idle keys are dropped. Default 16384.

status.description: Status for rejected requests, 503 by default.

RealIPPolicy.description: RealIPPolicy is nginx set_real_ip_from, real_ip_header and real_ip_recursive: the client address is taken from a header that trusted proxies set. It applies to the whole site, before the route is chosen, so only site policies may be realIp.

from.description: Trusted proxies, as CIDRs or addresses.

header.description: Default "X-Real-IP"; "X-Forwarded-For" is read from the right.

recursive.description: Skip trusted addresses from the right of the header.

Redirects.description: Redirects is nginx proxy_redirect. Nil: only the default rule, which maps "http://<upstream name>/" ("https://" with upstream TLS) to "/", the Host the proxy sends.

default.description: Keep the default rule first (proxy_redirect default).

rules.description: Tried in order after the default rule when Default is set.

Retry.description: Retry is nginx proxy_next_upstream. Nil: on error and timeout.

status.description: 0-999. 444 closes the connection without a response.

text.description: Location for 301, 302, 303, 307 and 308, otherwise the body.

regex.description: PCRE2 pattern matched against the path.

children.description: Nested route IDs (nginx location inside a prefix location). Their paths must lie inside this route's prefix.

errorPages.description: Empty inherits the parent route's, then the site's.

inheritPolicies.description: False drops the policies of the parent route and the site.

internal.description: Only internal redirects (error pages, try_files, rewrites) and subrequests reach the route; a client request for it gets 404 (nginx internal).

mirror.description: Copies of each request sent to other paths, whose answers are dropped (nginx mirror). Nil: none.

policies.description: Policy IDs added to those of the parent route and the site.

SSIFilter.description: SSIFilter is nginx ssi with ssi_silent_errors, ssi_types, ssi_value_length and ssi_last_modified: include (virtual and file), echo, set, if/elif/else/endif, config and block commands in responses.

enabled.description: False turns off an ssi filter inherited from further out (ssi off).

lastModified.description: Keep Last-Modified and send ETag weak.

silentErrors.description: Leave no "[an error occurred while processing the directive]".

types.description: Media types processed besides text/html, or "*" for any.

valueLength.description: Longest parameter value in bytes. Zero: 256.

certificates.description: Certificate IDs offered on TLS listeners, at most one per key type.

errorPages.description: Inherited by routes that set none of their own, as in nginx.

policies.description: Policy IDs applied to every route of the site.

redirectHttpToHttps.description: On plain listeners, answer every request with a 301 to https.

rewrite.description: Server-level rewrites, run before a route is chosen.

routes.description: Route IDs in display order. Matching priority does not depend on it.

percent.description: Such as "0.5%" or "20%"; "*" takes the rest and must come last.

SplitClients.description: SplitClients is nginx split_clients: the source's hash picks a bucket by percentage.

autoindex.description: List directories without an index file (nginx autoindex). Nil: off.

dav.description: WebDAV methods on the files under Root (nginx dav_methods). Nil: off.

randomIndex.description: Send a request for a directory to a random file in it (nginx random_index).

Sticky.description: Sticky keeps a client on one target.

maxAge.description: cookie: lifetime such as "1h". Empty: a session cookie.

route.description: route: variables tried in order, such as "$cookie_jsessionid"; the first non-empty one is matched against target routes.

serverNames.description: SNI names, like a site's hostnames (nginx map $ssl_preread_server_name or server_name in a stream server). Empty: every session.

address.description: host:port. A TCP stream must not share it with a listener.

noNextUpstream.description: Do not try another target when connecting fails (nginx proxy_next_upstream off).

policies.description: Policy IDs: ipAccess, connLimit and accessLog apply (nginx allow, deny, limit_conn and access_log in a stream server).

proxyProtocol.description: Send a PROXY protocol v1 header to the upstream (nginx proxy_protocol on). TCP only.

responses.description: UDP: responses expected per datagram; the session ends after them (nginx proxy_responses). Nil: until the timeout.

routes.description: The first route whose serverNames match the session's SNI name serves it; a route without names matches every session.

sslPreread.description: Read the SNI name and ALPN from the ClientHello without terminating TLS (nginx ssl_preread), for routing by serverNames. TCP only.

timeout.description: Idle time after which the session ends (nginx proxy_timeout). Empty: "10m".

tls.description: TLS termination (nginx listen ssl); defaultCertificate is required. TCP only.

tries.description: Targets tried at most. Zero: all (nginx proxy_next_upstream_tries).

SubFilter.description: SubFilter is nginx sub_filter with sub_filter_once, sub_filter_types and sub_filter_last_modified: text replaced in responses, matched without regard to case. No pairs turns off a sub filter inherited from further out.

all.description: Replace every occurrence, not only the first (sub_filter_once off).

lastModified.description: Keep Last-Modified and send ETag weak.

types.description: Media types besides text/html, or "*" for any.

SubPair.description: SubPair is one sub_filter: both are templates with variables such as $host; a match empty once expanded is skipped.

backup.description: Used only when no other target is available.

maxConns.description: Requests in progress at most; zero: no limit (nginx max_conns).

resolve.description: Re-resolve the host name while running (nginx resolve).

resolveInterval.description: How often a resolve target is looked up again. Empty: "30s".

route.description: Sticky route value naming this target (nginx server route=).

slowStart.description: After recovering, the weight grows from 1 over this time, e.g. "30s" (nginx slow_start).

TryFiles.description: TryFiles is nginx try_files. Exactly one of URI, Status and Route is the fallback.

files.description: Paths under Root; a trailing "/" matches a directory.

route.description: Route ID, like an nginx named location (@name).

discovery.description: Targets found at run time and added to Targets, which may then be empty. Nil: only Targets.

healthCheck.description: Active health checks (probes from every node). Nil: none.

queue.description: Requests waiting when every target is at maxConns (nginx queue).

tls.description: TLS to the targets (nginx proxy_pass https:// and proxy_ssl_*). Nil: plain TCP.

UpstreamTLS.description: UpstreamTLS configures connections to an upstream's targets.

ca.description: PEM CA certificates to trust (nginx proxy_ssl_trusted_certificate). Empty: the system store.

certificate.description: Certificate ID presented to targets (nginx proxy_ssl_certificate).

depth.description: Chain length at most (nginx proxy_ssl_verify_depth). Zero: 1.

serverName.description: Name for SNI and certificate verification (nginx proxy_ssl_name). Empty: the upstream name.

verify.description: Check the target's chain and name (nginx proxy_ssl_verify).

UseridFilter.description: UseridFilter is nginx userid with its userid_* settings: a visitor cookie and the $uid_got and $uid_set variables.

expires.description: Cookie lifetime such as "365d" in seconds, or "max" for 2037. Empty: a session cookie.

mark.description: A letter, digit or "=" written into cookies (userid_mark).

service.description: First word of new identifiers (userid_service). Nil: the server's IPv4 address for version 2, 0 for version 1.

ValueMatch.description: ValueMatch is one condition on a header or query argument, compared with the raw value as sent.

WAFException.description: WAFException turns off one rule, for requests whose path starts with Path when set.

note.description: Why, for whoever reads the policy later.

WAFPolicy.description: WAFPolicy filters requests with the Coraza web application firewall, ModSecurity rules with the OWASP Core Rule Set, run as a proxy-wasm plugin. In detect mode matches are only logged; block answers 403.

anomalyThreshold.description: Inbound anomaly score that blocks. Default 5.

exceptions.description: Rules turned off, everywhere or under a path.

failOpen.description: When the firewall fails, pass the request on instead of answering 500.

module.description: SHA-256 of an uploaded coraza-proxy-wasm module, lowercase hex.

noCrs.description: Leave out the OWASP Core Rule Set; only rules apply.

requestBody.description: Inspect the request body, up to maxBody (default "1m").

rules.description: More ModSecurity directives (SecLang), one per entry, after the CRS.

WasmPolicy.description: WasmPolicy runs a proxy-wasm (ABI 0.2) plugin in the access phase of the routes it applies to: it sees the request headers and, with requestBody, the body, then the response headers, and may answer itself. Every wasm and waf policy that applies runs, outermost first.

failOpen.description: When the plugin fails, pass the request on instead of answering 500.

maxMemory.description: Memory of one instance at most. Default "256m".

module.description: SHA-256 of an uploaded module, lowercase hex.

pluginName.description: Plugin name, its root ID. Default the policy name.

requestBody.description: Buffer the request body for the plugin, up to maxBody (default "1m").

timeout.description: Time one callback may run. Default "1s".
